title: Super Paper Mario ~ The Lost Pages (Made with Claude, Fork of New Super Paper Bros by  josiahg2502-glitch.
author: Safe-Worldliness7321
selftext:
Very early and very rough around the edges, but this project intends to revive mechanics from TTYD into SPM while also adding new content, story, and mechanics that fit the games theming.

(Disclaimer - Super Paper Mario is owned by Nintendo and Intelligent Systems, Original Recomp by  josiahg2502-glitch, I do not claim ownership for any assets, even the ones Claude made for me.)

https://i.redd.it/vmf30a71sfyh1.png

Everything is subject to change, again very early. You can view my repo at https://github.com/BigWatermelonMan/NewSuperPaperBros/tree/lost-pages.

There is no guarantee that I will finish this but i will try my best.
